items.question: How soon do I see results?
items.answer: First insights appear immediately after analysis. Practical growth results start appearing between 30-60 days with consistent strategy application.

items.question: Does it work for any niche?
items.answer: Yes! Our methodology is adaptable to all niches. We've worked with gaming, lifestyle, education, tech, entertainment and many others.

items.question: Do I need many subscribers?
items.answer: No! We work from beginner channels to creators with millions of followers. Our strategies are adapted for each growth stage.

items.question: Is support included?
items.answer: Yes, all plans include support during implementation. The Complete plan includes monthly follow-up.

personalAbout.title: À propos Me
personalAbout.description: Data Scientist & Full Stack Developer focused on digital growth
personalAbout.intro: I'm Gabriel Toth Gonçalves, a senior data scientist and Full Stack developer from Brazil. With a Computer Science degree and specialization in Data Science, I currently work on the social-analytics-engine project, performing advanced digital campaign analysis and conversion metrics.
personalAbout.experience: My work involves integrating Google Analytics data with social media metrics (YouTube, Instagram, X, Telegram) and Stripe conversion analysis using Python, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Docker. I also develop enterprise web solutions, having created sites like softclever.com.br (React) and sistemasatfiscal.com.br (Angular).
personalAbout.passion: Beyond data analysis, I have an impressive case: I reached over 1 million views on a channel that still had less than 1000 subscribers. I've been managing channels since 2013 and use machine learning to optimize campaigns across multiple platforms.
